name: Honke Matsuura
about: Honke Matsuura Shuzoba brews in Oasa, Naruto, Tokushima. The second-generation Matsuura Naozo began brewing in 1804, and the Naruto Tai trademark was registered in 1886.

The brewery uses Tokushima rice and yeast. In 1993 it released a sudachi liqueur, in 2000 it sold what it calls the first mist-brewed nama sake, and in 2005 it released a cloudy umeshu. Its old brewhouse was registered as a tangible cultural property in 2002.
